name: two-col-list
description: 双栏清单：左右各三条逐条入场（密集信息罗列）
css: #tpl-two-col-list { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 8vw; background: var(--ground, #0a0a1a); } .tcl { flex: 1; } .tcl li { list-style: none; font-size: 2.5vh; line-height: 1.5; margin: 1.8vh 0; color: var(--ink, #f0f0f5); padding-left: 2.6vh; position: relative; opacity: 0; } .tcl li::before { content: "·"; position: absolute; left: .6vh; color: var(--ink, #f0f0f5); font-weight: 800; }
timeline: tl.fromTo("{tpl} .tcl:first-child li", { opacity: 0, x: -30 }, { opacity: 1, x: 0, duration: 0.4, ease: "power2.out", stagger: 0.2 }, {start});tl.fromTo("{tpl} .tcl:last-child li", { opacity: 0, x: 30 }, { opacity: 1, x: 0, duration: 0.4, ease: "power2.out", stagger: 0.2 }, {start} + 0.35);
